offers.title: Create: AI Influencer Reel & Video Ad
offers.description: Researches what is trending now on TikTok and Instagram Reels (cited sources), designs an original AI influencer persona, writes a 15-20 second Reel / video-ad script on one cited trend, renders persona-consistent keyframes for every scene, and generates the vertical AI video: a 9:16 MP4 with motion, burned-in captions and voiceover.
offers.deliverable: Trend-based AI video (9:16 MP4 reel / ad with captions and voiceover), persona card, scene-by-scene script citing the trend URL, persona reference portrait and scene keyframe images, caption, hashtags, photo concepts and a 7-day post plan

offers.title: Script: Trend-based Reels & TikToks
offers.description: Researches what is trending right now on TikTok and Instagram Reels for your niche (cited sources), then writes production-ready short-video scripts tied to those trends: 0-3s hook, timestamped beats, on-screen text, voiceover, shot list, sound reference, caption, hashtags, CTA and TikTok vs Reels variants.
offers.deliverable: Trend-linked short-video scripts with hooks, beats, shot lists, captions and platform variants, plus the cited trend analysis

offers.deliverable: Ranked trend table with evidence links, evidence log, how-to-use notes per top trend, method and limits
